shots.name: 01-awakening
shots.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full bleed portrait 9:16 illustration (prefer 1024x1792 or equivalent portrait), NOT a montage or comic page, no text, no borders, no UI. Part of a coherent six-shot prologue for the existing dark fairy tale game.
Reference 1 is the EXACT heroine design: blonde bangs and loose blonde locks, red eyes, pointed crimson hood, dark brown belted leather short dress with ivory scalloped trim, brown fingerless gloves and tall strapped boots. Adult young woman with stylized anime game proportions. Change pose/expression from reference; no cup. Hood attached to a SHORT torn cape whose lowest resting hem ends at HIP/BUTTOCK level: not a shoulder-only shawl, absolutely no knee/ankle length cloak, no trailing red ribbons. No weapon, no lantern carried, no numbers/tattoos.
Reference 2 is the game environment/style: chunky confident dark ink contours, stylized painted shapes, cool muted blue-gray and moss forest, warm amber flame light. Match its 2D game illustration language, NOT photorealism, NOT cinematic live-action, NOT 3D; reduce tiny texture noise. Ignore reference enemies and UI and do not copy long flowing cape. Dusk approaching night, not pitch-black midnight. Story cutscene composition, not an overhead world-map asset.
Continuity for any visible village: small weathered timber village still intact, one crooked gable house with a small square side window, low circular stone well with one chipped rim stone, a forked fence post near woodland edge. Ritual at wooden post with adult villagers in plain brown/gray medieval clothes. They are calm and ordinary-looking, no obvious monsters. Fire victim is an adult red-hooded woman, distant and anonymous, face hidden, no gore, no visible burns. Keep key story content away from bottom 15% reserved for later subtitles; paint natural background there, no blank box.
SHOT 1 AWAKENING. Medium-wide slightly downward view of heroine sitting beside thick gnarled tree roots, one gloved hand planted on wet leaves, other hand near temple. Confused just-awakened expression, grounded natural anatomy, knees and boots visible. Short cape rests at seat/hip, never pools on ground. Forest roots shelter her in a loose semicircle. Sparse brambles, mossy gray stones, tiny dew-covered web in a corner, no village yet, no fire, no monster revealed. Soft cold dusk through foliage. Face and supporting hand are focal points; environmental shadows frame her. No skulls, corpses, spectacle, or magic.
